column1: # Immutable substitutions for absolute-URL `$ref`s and complete pinned source
# trees for relative-file `$ref`s. Both make a row's byte-match verdict depend
# only on recorded inputs rather than a mutable upstream branch.
#   corpus_name  a canonical CORPUS.md numbered row name (its third cell)
#   mutable_url  the absolute `$ref` URL as the upstream root document writes it,
#   pinned_url   the immutable URL substituted for it
#   sha256       lowercase hex SHA-256 of the bytes served at `pinned_url`
#   tree path    repository-relative path, shared by Fern and crozier; every
#                member of one tree uses its CORPUS.md row's commit SHA
# `#` comments and blank lines are ignored; each record kind sorts by
# revision the committed `helios-verifiable-api` golden was generated from: the
# unresolvable safe and finalized tags as unknown blocks (#879)").
